A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 63-page PrOSV study, including readable appendices A–P. Page-by-page text and rendering comparisons establish that pages 2–63 are identical; changes are confined to page 1.

before.justification: v1 reports original steering, model-capability, and robustness experiments in Section 6, with additional empirical analyses in Appendices J–N.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and appendix analyses, including the authors' PrOSV results in Tables 2 and 13.

M1.justification: Joint training of steering factors and directions, PrOSV intervention locations, training objectives, and inference procedures are unchanged in Sections 4–5 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Both versions use CONCEPT10/CONCEPT500, AlpacaEval instructions, tinyMMLU, and tinyGSM8K. Concept-suppression attacks, extended-context evaluation, and appendix test scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 2 and corresponding appendix comparisons retain the same prompting, FSSV/RePS, LoReFT, DiffMean, and SAE comparators, with unchanged participation in each experiment.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendices J–N retain identical model/layer configurations, sample sizes, hyperparameter grids, evaluation metrics, and testing procedures.

E4.justification: The hyperparameter and intervention-location analyses, robustness tests, failure cases, attention analysis, steering-direction comparisons, and data-scaling experiment are all unchanged.

E5.justification: Seed specifications, cross-concept standard deviations, the ten-seed RePS replication in Appendix L.2, and Figure 50's standard errors are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match, including the appendices. For example, Table 2 retains PrOSV with SimPO scores of 0.803, 0.905, and 1.102 for Gemma2-2B, Gemma2-9B, and Qwen2.5-32B, respectively.

T1.justification: Section 4's scaling analysis, stability and efficiency definitions, and learning-rate derivations are identical. Appendix E's lemmas, proofs, and clamping-intervention analysis are also unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about principled joint training, effective prompt-only steering, and the model-utility versus robustness tradeoff.

C2.justification: Interpretations of intervention mechanisms, model-scale effects, and robustness tradeoffs are unchanged, as are Section 7's limitations and the qualifications in the appendices.

D1.justification: v2 adds first-page Code, Data, and Checkpoints links to a GitHub repository and two Hugging Face repositories absent from v1. Appendix A still lists anonymous proof-of-concept code and promises later releases. These are new access pointers; the PDFs do not establish resource completeness.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, related-work discussion in Section 2 and Appendix D, and positioning relative to previous steering methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: Page 1 gains the short Code, Data, and Checkpoints line and updated arXiv version/date text. Scientific prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page abstract block is repositioned to accommodate the artifact links and icons. All figures, tables, captions, and the rendered layout of pages 2–63 are identical.

improvement.justification: The new explicit artifact links improve discoverability and reproducibility documentation compared with v1's anonymous proof-of-concept link and promised releases. The benefit is limited: scientific content is unchanged, Appendix A retains future-release wording, and resource contents cannot be verified from the PDFs.
